claim: Minnesota voters are choosing a GHOST CANDIDATE who is NOT REAL. "Ilhan Omar" as it appears on the ballot is not a real person!!
read: A high-engagement post claims voters are choosing a ghost candidate and that the name Ilhan Omar on the ballot is not a real person. A federal court filing in the search-warrant matter lists the subject as Congresswoman Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, a/k/a Ilhan Abdullahi Omar. a/k/a means also known as. The filing does not find that the ballot name is nonexistent. Official House records, the Biographical Directory, and her office site list her as Ilhan Omar, the sitting Representative from Minnesota's 5th District. Her office has stated that Ilhan Omar is her real name. The claim does not match the cited record. The interesting fact is the alternate name in the motion. The missing fact is that a/k/a is not a finding of a fake ballot identity.

script: Midday Check. A post says Minnesota voters are choosing a ghost candidate. The name Ilhan Omar on the ballot is not a real person. A federal filing in the search-warrant case lists the subject as Congresswoman Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, a/k/a Ilhan Abdullahi Omar. a/k/a means also known as. Official House records list her as Ilhan Omar, the Representative from Minnesota's Fifth District. Her office says that is her real name. The claim does not match the cited record. Verdict: contradicted.

claim: Everyone thought she came in second or third, but then she 'won.'
read: In a Saturday-night Truth Social post, the president wrote that Lisa Murkowski only got elected because of ranked-choice voting and that everyone thought she came in second or third before she won. The official 2022 Alaska Division of Elections first-choice tally shows Murkowski finishing first with 113,495 votes (43.37 percent) to Kelly Tshibaka's 111,480 (42.60 percent). She led the initial count by roughly 2,000 votes; second-choice ballots from eliminated candidates then expanded her margin to 53.7 percent. The claim does not match the cited record. The interesting fact is the ranked-choice redistribution. The missing fact is that she already held the plurality before any redistribution.

sources.title: Alaska Division of Elections — 2022 General Election Official Summary Report

script: Morning Check. A Truth Social post says everyone thought Lisa Murkowski came in second or third, then she won under ranked-choice voting. The official first-choice tally from the Alaska Division of Elections shows she finished first with 113,495 votes, 43.37 percent, ahead of Kelly Tshibaka at 111,480 votes, 42.60 percent. She led the initial count. Second-choice ballots from the Democrat and a withdrawn Republican then widened the margin to 53.7 percent. The claim does not match the cited record. Verdict: contradicted.

claim: Heading to Michigan to fight a Jihadist Member of the Muslim Brotherhood. Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed is a Fake Doctor, who runs what is considered to be the WORST CLINIC IN AMERICA.
read: Bridge Michigan reviewed public records and found no evidence that El-Sayed is a member of or pledged support to the Muslim Brotherhood. He has disavowed the group. He holds an MD from Columbia and a public-health doctorate from Oxford, but did not complete residency and has never held a medical license in Michigan or New York. He has said he does not practice medicine. The claim does not match the cited record. The interesting fact is the campaign attack. The missing fact is the degree and the absence of membership evidence.

script: Late Check. A Truth Social post says the president is heading to Michigan to fight a Jihadist Member of the Muslim Brotherhood, a Fake Doctor who runs the worst clinic in America. Bridge Michigan reviewed the record and found no evidence of membership or a pledge of support. El-Sayed has disavowed the group. He holds a medical degree from Columbia. He did not complete residency and has never held a license to practice in Michigan or New York. He has said he does not practice medicine. The claim does not match the cited record.
